parole.significato: Small disc- or tube-shaped beads made from shells or stones, primarily associated with the Kewa Pueblo.
parole.testo: Variously said to be from a word for "white shell", "shell", or "shell bead" in Eastern Keres [Term?].

parole.significato: A federally recognized Pueblo people living in New Mexico; more commonly known as the Santo Domingo.
parole.testo: Possibly borrowed from Eastern Keres Kyiwa.

parole.significato: A jester or trickster in the Kachina religion of the Pueblo Indians of the southwestern USA, also called a sacred clown.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Eastern Keres [Term?] or Western Keres [Term?]
